kids.body: Diffraction-limited blur of the infrared payload, as an angle: 2.44 lambda / D.
Jitter and attitude-knowledge error are non-negative angles.
First-order nadir physics: X = h (blur + eps) and L = h thetaK + dr.
Low Earth orbit between 500 km and 700 km.
Line-of-sight jitter during integration of at most 5 urad (planted shortfall).
Revised jitter allocation: at most 3 urad.
Orbit position error of at most 100 m.
